tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Use to find cards. Lists events newest first with the venue, status, number of fights and main event. Filter by season (year) and status (scheduled or final). Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Use for one card: every fight in order with the result, method, round and time, judges' scores and referee. Costs 2 credits.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for upcoming fights: every scheduled bout in the next N days (default 30) with the current moneyline from any book that has posted one. Costs 2 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

tools.name: get_fight
tools.description: Use for everything about one fight: the result, both fighters' full stat sheets (strikes by target and position, takedowns, control time, guard passes, reversals, submission attempts; UFC only, null elsewhere and where the source has no sheet), round-by-round lines (UFC only), each fighter's rating

tools.name: search_fighters
tools.description: Use to find a fighter's id by name or nickname (accents optional). Returns weight class, country, pro record, number of fights in the promotion (bouts; ufc_bouts for the UFC only) and last fight date. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: get_fighter
tools.description: Use for one fighter's profile: date of birth, height, reach, stance, gym, record in the promotion by method (record; ufc_record is the same for the UFC and null for other promotions), career rates per 15 minutes from the stat sheets (significant strikes landed and absorbed, accuracy, defense, takedo

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Use for our fighter ratings: an Elo built from the promotion's own results (the UFC since 2000), highest first, for fighters active since a given year (default last year). Filter by weight class. Costs 2 credits.
